rounds.reason: Machinery only: this round builds the census mechanism itself (scripts/check-census.py, the census gate in scripts/push.py, the census ride-along in scripts/select-tier.py, gate and select-tier fixtures, TESTING.md rule 7, DEVELOPMENT_RULES section 1) and changes no parts/ surface, so there are no anchors to enumerate. The gate-fixture suite proves the exemption is the round's record, not the gate's: a machinery-only push needs no census, and a parts push without one is refused.

Machinery only: /correct Phase 3 round (d) adds scripts/check-mirrors.py + the mirrors gate in push.py, derives the packfields cap list, names brand-snow.js in the foreign-writes census exclusions and fixes the app1-types.d.ts applyNight home part (a comment in a never-assembled declaration file). No parts/ surface changes.
